aggregation: Parse each labeled response into a SALMON triplet [head, winner, loser] where head is the anchor and winner is the candidate judged closer. Fit salmon.triplets.offline.OfflineEmbedding on pooled triplet runs with d=5, then compute the RDM as cosine distance (1 - cosine similarity) between embedded concepts. Per-run SALMON fits and split-half SALMON fits are used for reliability.
notes: Category-level safety-policy concepts only; no operational harmful content.
